text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Cesario, you're throwing a birthday 
party for me~?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I reserved a spot in the cafeteria 
and invited some friends over. Make sure 
you're on time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I baked the cake you once mentioned you 
liked, and I'll brew some hot cocoa too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And the other things you said you wanted 
to eat again—roast beef, carbonara, 
prosciutto salad, minestrone, and then—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Y-You prepared that much for me!? And you 
remembered eveeery single thing too...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh, what do I do?! I'm so happy! But 
since you went so all out for me, I have 
no idea how I'll ever repay you...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
What should I do?! Cesario, is there 
anything you want me to do?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Today is your birthday, after all. 
As long as you enjoy it to the fullest, 
that's more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! I want to keep passing along 
all this happiness! That way, everyone 
gets to be even happier!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: You mean passing on the joy?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Fine, I'll think about it. Geez, once 
you get an idea in your head, there's no 
stopping you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That's right~! Prepare yourself, because 
we're gonna be happy together♪
